procedures.name: KARBU 1W
procedures.description: Climb on R 324 KIP to D6, then turn right to intercept R 265 YJU/D13, then proceed to YJU. turn right to track outbound R 127 YJU until joining G597. then at or below FL 250 until joining G597. then resume normal CG.
restrictions: Cross R 265 YJU/D13 at or above 4 300 ft, R 127 YJU/D5 between 8 000 ft and 10 000 ft,
Minimum CG 7% to 4 300 ft for noise abatement, then resume normal CG.
Request of this procedure shall be made at least 10 minutes prior to take-off.
